notes.title: 🚀 On the Road to 50K Wishlists! 🚀
notes.notes: [p]Early Access is heating up, and we’re chasing our next big milestone — [b]50,000 wishlists![/b] 🏅[/p][p]Hit that number, and an [b][i]exclusive special badge[/i][/b] will drop for everyone who’s part of the journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/d90c63b99cb273c0da9df0ad3ce0c4804df5f435.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re already at [b][i]40,243 wishlists[/i][/b], and every single one brings us closer.[/p][p]Even better — we’re close to unlocking our next mini-milestone reward, so it’s double the goodies. 🎁[/p][p][/p][p]📌 How to help:[/p][p][b]Wishlist [i]Avakin Life[/i] right here on Steam.[/b][/p][p]Spread the word — tell your friends, family, and squad to do the same.[/p][p]The faster we reach 50K, the faster you’ll have that badge in your hands.[/p][p]Let’s make it happen! 💚[/p]

notes.title: 2.11.0 Patch update!
notes.notes: [p]Good news, Avakins! 🎉[/p][p]We’ve fixed the loading screen issue that was causing some players to get stuck at 60%.[/p][p]You can now jump back in, explore, and enjoy Avakin Life without delays. Thank you so much for your patience while we worked to get you back in the game![/p][p]We hear you and 💖 your feedback! Every comment helps us improve Avakin Life, so keep sharing your thoughts and ideas![/p]

notes.notes: [h3][b]We’ve hit another huge milestone — 40,000 wishlists! 🎉[/b][/h3][p]That means the [b]Desktop Set reward[/b] is on its way to everyone. 🖥✨ Perfect for adding a little extra flair to your space.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/4fd842cb5c84f05f8da5962788a441523107fc27.png"][/img][/p][p]But the journey’s not over yet…[/p][p][/p][p]The next milestone is [b]50K wishlists[/b], and the reward?[/p][p][/p][p][b]🏅 A special in-game badge to show you were part of this milestone moment.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s keep the momentum going — more wishlists = more rewards and surprises ahead. 🚀[/p][p]Thank you all for your incredible support. 💚[/p]
